title: Тонкие Смыслы (Перевод-Ловушка)
description: Переведи, выбрав Past Simple или Present Perfect.

items.question: Я только что потерял телефон. I ___ my phone.
options: I have just lost my phone.
items.answer: I have just lost my phone.

items.question: Я потерял телефон вчера. I ___ my phone yesterday.
options: I have lost my phone yesterday.

items.question: Мы уже купили билеты. We ___ the tickets.
options: We have already bought the tickets.
items.answer: We have already bought the tickets.

items.question: Мы купили билеты на прошлой неделе. We ___ the tickets last week.
options: We bought the tickets last week.
We have bought the tickets last week.
items.answer: We bought the tickets last week.

items.question: Она еще не закончила проект. She ___ the project ___.
options: She hasn't finished the project yet.
She didn't finish the project yet.
items.answer: She hasn't finished the project yet.

items.question: Она не закончила проект в пятницу. She ___ the project on Friday.
options: She didn't finish the project on Friday.
She hasn't finished the project on Friday.
items.answer: She didn't finish the project on Friday.
